items.t: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
items.d: The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.
items.fullText: Tesla just revealed its redesigned second-generation Roadster with SpaceX thrusters, a vehicle CEO Elon Musk has called “the best of the last of the human-driven cars.” Musk showed off the car at an event outside Waco, Texas, with a demonstration that saw the car use a mixture of high-powered fans and thrusters to drive up an inverted ramp, spin around, and ease itself to a landing on the pavement below. The car also used the thrusters to lift itself over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 while in motion. “This will be the actual car that’s on the roads,” Musk said of the car, which Tesla showed accelerating 0 to 60 miles per hour in one second. “It literally is just going to puff itself up, and uh, and be able to do this, these maneuvers whenever you’d like.” Musk said Tesla will finally build the long-delayed vehicle in 2028, but didn’t name a price. Tesla will offer it in three trims. The first is “Performance,” which Tesla describes as “road ready.” It seats two, has active aerodynamics, and features a “multi-mode suction system for next-level performance on and off the track.” The second trim is “Thrust,” which is “race ready” and seats two, and has rear-mounted cold-gas thrusters that enable sub-one-second 0-to-60 mph accleration. The third is “Rocket,” which is “air ready” and seats one, and has 10 cold-gas thrusters positioned around the car. All three trims will have 300 miles of range and be capable of speeds exceeding 230 miles per hour. Tesla’s website showed Thursday the company is taking reservations for the car, charging $50,000 just to reserve the Performance, and $250,000 for Thrust. AI 기사요약 노르웨이 정부 전문가위원회가 국부펀드의 동맹국 핵무기 관련 기업 투자 금지 완화를 권고함에 따라 장기 수익성 확보와 윤리적 투자 원칙 간의 논쟁이 심화되고 있습니다. 로이터연합뉴스 노르웨이 정부가 위촉한 전문가위원회가 2조3000억달러 규모 국부펀드의 핵무기 관련 기업 투자 금지 규정을 완화하라고 권고했다. 세계 최대 국부펀드의 투자 대상이 미국과 영국, 프랑스의 주요 방산업체로 확대될 수 있어 장기 수익성과 윤리적 투자 원칙을 둘러싼 논쟁이 커지고 있다. 16일 파이낸셜타임스(FT)에 따르면 노르웨이 정부가 국부펀드의 윤리적 투자 지침을 검토하도록 구성한 전문가위원회는 노르웨이와 동맹 관계에 있는 핵보유국 소재 기업에 대한 투자 금지를 해제할 것을 권고했다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김주완 기자 한국경제신문 국제부 기자입니다. 이전에 테크 분야를 9년 동안 취재했습니다. 경제부처에선 5년 동안 기사를 썼습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in France’s Startups Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. October 12, 2026 by Nat Ives 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics . Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic , Genesis AI and Pigment . These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning. Doctolib , a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. Entalpic , a Paris-based startup, accelerates the engineering of advanced materials at the atomic scale, with particular expertise in surfaces and interfaces for semiconductor manufacturing and next-generation electronics. Genesis AI is a global robotics company developing general-purpose robots with frontier intelligence and capabilities through its foundation models, data collection systems, simulation infrastructure and robot hardware.
